description: This Java class implements a request-response template for a queue system, managing pending requests, response processing, timeouts, and thread management within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultTbQueueRequestTemplate
classes.description: A template class for managing request-response interactions over a queue, handling timeouts, pending requests, and response processing.

classes.name: ResponseMetaData
classes.description: A data class holding metadata for a pending response, including timestamps, timeout, and the future object.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the queue topic, subscribes to responses, and starts the main processing loop.

methods.name: mainLoop
methods.description: Main processing loop that fetches and processes responses continuously until stopped.

methods.name: fetchAndProcessResponses
methods.description: Polls responses from the queue, processes each response, and cleans stale requests.

methods.name: tryCleanStaleRequests
methods.description: Attempts to clean up requests that have timed out, using locking to prevent concurrent cleanup.

methods.name: setupNextCleanup
methods.description: Schedules the next cleanup based on the maximum request timeout.

methods.name: doPoll
methods.description: Performs polling of responses from the response queue.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of nanoseconds.

methods.name: setTimeoutException
methods.description: Sets a TimeoutException on a response future if the request has timed out.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes an incoming response, matching it to a pending request and completing its future.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the request template, unsubscribes from response queue, and shuts down executor if internal.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request with default timeout.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request with specified timeout.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request to a specific partition.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Core method to send a request, assign request ID, and track pending request.

methods.name: getCurrentClockNs
methods.description: Returns a monotonic clock value in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getCurrentTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the current wall clock time in milliseconds.

methods.name: sendToRequestTemplate
methods.description: Sends the request to the queue and handles success or failure callbacks.
